Both answered below with grep-derived counts.

## Q-h10 — Highest fan-in function under `internal/`

**Winner: `util.GenUUID()`** — declared at `/bench/repo/internal/util/util.go:40`

- **~28 total call sites** repo-wide, **7 non-test**.
- Non-test callers (7, spanning 6 distinct packages/files):
  - `/bench/repo/server/auth/token.go:194`
  - `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go:26` and `:135`
  - `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service_storage.go:209`
  - `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:154`
  - `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sso_username.go:15`
  - `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_access_tokens.go:84`
- Test callers dominate the total: 19 hits in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/test/auth_test.go` alone, plus `test/authz_test.go` and `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go`.

**Runner-up depends on whether tests count:**
- By total: `scheduler.New()` at `/bench/repo/internal/scheduler/scheduler.go:54` — 12 total, but only 2 non-test.
- By non-test: `filter.DefaultEngine()` at `/bench/repo/internal/filter/engine.go:111` — 7 hits, all non-test. Close behind, `filter.AppendConditions()` at `/bench/repo/internal/filter/helpers.go:9` — 6, all non-test; `util.ConvertStringToInt32()` at `/bench/repo/internal/util/util.go:14` — 5, all non-test; `s3.NewClient()` at `/bench/repo/internal/storage/s3/s3.go:25` — 5.

Notes on method fan-in (checked so the "or method" part is covered): methods declared under `internal/` have negligible fan-in — the heaviest, `markdown.Service.GenerateSnippet`, has 4 hits (1 non-test); `RenderHTML` 1, `ExtractTags` 1, `RenameTag` 1. No method comes close to `GenUUID`. Also, `internal/base` declares no functions at all — only the `UIDMatcher` regexp var (`/bench/repo/internal/base/resource_name.go:6`), referenced 8 times.

Full ranking of internal exported funcs by total/non-test call sites:

| symbol | total | non-test |
|---|---|---|
| `util.GenUUID` | 28 | 7 |
| `scheduler.New` | 12 | 2 |
| `filter.DefaultEngine` | 7 | 7 |
| `filter.AppendConditions` | 6 | 6 |
| `util.ConvertStringToInt32` | 5 | 5 |
| `s3.NewClient` | 5 | 5 |
| `filter.DefaultAttachmentEngine` | 4 | 4 |
| `version.IsVersionGreaterThan` | 4 | 4 |
| `markdown.NewService` | 4 | 2 |

(Several exported helpers are entirely dead outside their own package: `util.HasPrefixes`, `util.ValidateEmail`, `util.ReplaceString`, `httpgetter.GetImage`, `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta`, `webhook.Post`, `version.GetMinorVersion`, `filter.NewEngine`/`NewSchema`/`NewAttachmentSchema`, `email.NewClient` — 0 qualified call sites.)

## Q-h11 — Store entity referenced from the most distinct external packages

Counting distinct directories (Go packages) outside `store/` and `store/db/` that contain `store.<Type>` references:

**1st: `store.User`** — declared at `/bench/repo/store/user.go:29`
- **7 distinct external packages** (6 excluding test-only packages), **93 references** across **30 files**:
  - `server/router/api/v1` (19 files)
  - `server/router/api/v1/test` (3)
  - `server/router/rss` (2)
  - `server/router/fileserver` (2)
  - `server/auth` (2)
  - `server/router/frontend` (1)
  - `server/notification` (1)

**2nd: `store.Memo`** — declared at `/bench/repo/store/memo.go:35`
- **6 distinct external packages** (4 non-test), **64 references** across **21 files**:
  - `server/router/api/v1` (13 files), `server/router/api/v1/test` (3), `server/router/rss` (2), `server/runner/memopayload` (1), `server/router/frontend` (1), `server/notification` (1)

**3rd: `store.Attachment`** — declared at `/bench/repo/store/attachment.go:16` — 4 external packages (`server/router/api/v1`, `.../v1/test`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/fileserver`), 43 references, 12 files.

Full ranking (external packages / non-test packages / references / files):

| `User` | 7 | 6 | 93 | 30 |
| `Memo` | 6 | 4 | 64 | 21 |

Two caveats worth flagging:
- There is no `plugin/` or `bin/` directory in this repo (root is `cmd/`, `internal/`, `server/`, `store/`, `proto/`, `web/`, `docs/`, `scripts/`), and `cmd/` contains **zero** `store.User`/`store.Memo` references — all entity usage is concentrated in `server/`.
- Raw symbol frequency outside `store/` tells the same story: `store.Memo` 162 occurrences, `store.User` 128, `store.Attachment` 100 (these larger numbers include the `store/test` and `store/db/*` packages that the package-count above excludes). `Memo` leads on raw reference volume while `User` leads on package spread, because `User` is touched by auth, RSS, fileserver, frontend, and notification alike.
- `Activity`, `Webhook`, and `Shortcut` are declared/used only within the store layer (or not as `store.`-qualified types) — `Shortcut` in particular lives in `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` as a proto/user-setting concept rather than a `store.Shortcut` entity.
